name: datto-saas-mcp
description: Every Datto SaaS Protection (Backupify) client in one local database: seat audits, protection gaps, backup health ranking, exit inventories and plan-first bulk seat changes.

datto_saas_base_url.title: Datto API base URL
datto_saas_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank for the Datto API host (https://api.datto.com/v1); set it only to send requests through your own proxy or a test server.

datto_saas_public_key.title: DATTO_SAAS_PUBLIC_KEY
datto_saas_public_key.description: Sets DATTO_SAAS_PUBLIC_KEY for the Datto SaaS Protection MCP server. Get a credential from https://portal.dattobackup.com/integrations/api.

datto_saas_secret_key.title: DATTO_SAAS_SECRET_KEY
datto_saas_secret_key.description: Sets DATTO_SAAS_SECRET_KEY for the Datto SaaS Protection MCP server. Get a credential from https://portal.dattobackup.com/integrations/api.

datto_saas_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
datto_saas_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read tools: datto-saas_execute refuses the seat bulk change, and sync, export and the other commands that change state are not offered. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

datto_saas_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
datto_saas_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off and sync is refused. Leave blank to keep the local store.

datto_saas_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
datto_saas_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to the Datto API. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.

datto_saas_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
datto_saas_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
